description:
Bind a fleet DID to an ERC-8004 identity. Produces an order-independent,
    content-addressed (unsigned) binding attestation.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id where the ERC-8004 registry lives, for example 8453 for Base.
chain_id.title: Chain Id

fleet_did.description: The fleet DID to bind, from the identity server.
fleet_did.title: Fleet Did

proof_note.description: Optional. Where the binding proof can be checked.
proof_note.title: Proof Note

token_id.description: The agent's ERC-721 token id in the Identity Registry.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: bind_identity
title: Bind identity
